entries.2c469b271642487d: A company that undertakes facility construction work such as electrical work and piping work on contract from private companies, government agencies and the Tokyo Electric Power group.
entries.2f8b2ad363035df0: A category combining electrical equipment sales, real estate business, leasing business and power generation business, which is not included in the reportable segments. Kanko Shoji Co., Ltd. sells electrical materials such as electric wires; the company and Kasset Management Co., Ltd. run the real estate business; and Choshi Wind Power Development Co., Ltd., Kama Solar Power Generation Co., Ltd. and Maebashi Biomass Power Generation Co., Ltd. run the power generation business. The company, Choshi Wind Power Development Co., Ltd. and Maebashi Biomass Power Generation Co., Ltd. sell electricity to the Tokyo Electric Power Group. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,374 million.

entries.53f3dc2098678991: The company undertakes electrical and piping work and other construction projects for private-sector companies, government agencies and the Tokyo Electric Power Group, and earns revenue by receiving construction fees.
entries.63c285675984d555: A business that undertakes all kinds of facilities construction, including electrical construction and pipe construction (air conditioning, water supply and drainage, etc.). The company and construction firms centered on subsidiaries across the Kanto region share the construction work; the company outsources part of the construction, security at construction sites, and design and estimating work to group companies. The company and Tower Line Solutions Co., Ltd. also receive electrical construction orders from the Tokyo Electric Power Group. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥731,647 million, accounting for the majority of group revenue.

entries.921fc4b9fef10b39: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥63,516 million (149.9% year on year), achieving the performance target for fiscal 2026, the final year of the medium-term management plan, ahead of schedule and setting record-high results.
entries.9b8828528c975d4a: It undertakes electrical work, piping work and other facilities construction in general. Subsidiaries across the Kanto region share the electrical work and other construction, and the company places orders with group companies for part of the construction, construction site security, and design and cost estimation work. It purchases some of the electric wire and other materials used in construction from Kankō Shōji Co., Ltd.
entries.9ee7086ed1aef392: It says it will focus on sales activities in areas with high growth potential, such as AI, semiconductors and renewable energy, and on renovation proposals that contribute to solving customers' energy challenges. It also cites the reorganization of regional headquarters and branches in April 2026, and the strengthening of its air-conditioning and sanitary construction business through collaboration with group companies.

entries.cfd2cd62683b42b2: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥742,022 million (110.4% year on year). Of this, the Facilities Construction Business accounted for ¥731,647 million, and businesses not included in reportable segments, such as electrical equipment sales, real estate, leasing and power generation, accounted for ¥10,374 million. As private-sector construction investment remained solid, productivity improvements and optimization of construction systems contributed to improvements in the earnings structure.
